title: Edwin G Probable NDE 6341
content: I went to a friend’s house, at the time I was unaware that her boyfriend suspected we had more than just a friendship (but we did not). Her boyfriend was a drug addict and heavy drinker. It was just the three of us at their apartment and her boyfriend was being extra nice and offered me a drink, I accepted as it was Thanksgiving 2003. About 30 minutes later, I began to feel strange; it felt like a heavy uncontrollable shaking internally and then I felt extremely tired and dizzy and could not control what was happening. My friend’s boyfriend began to ask me ‘what's wrong, how do you feel?’ I replied, ‘what did you do to me?’ I sensed that I was going to die. He was trying to lure me into the bathroom, trying to convince me that I should take a bath. I knew that this was planned and could not tell if my friend was aware of her boyfriend's plans. By look on her face, she was scared, which made me more frightened. I felt the urge to kill her boyfriend before I was going to die. The feeling was getting worse so I walked out of the apartment and tried to find help. I only lived a few streets away and had left my cell phone at home. I started to lose the sense of time because before I knew it I was home. I had grabbed my cell phone and for some reason called a friend who could help in the event of my death. I left a message giving details. At this point, I could not stand up. I lay on my bed and closed my eyes. This was Thursday between 3 pm and 5 pm. I could not tell you exactly. As I lay on my bed, all I felt was my breaths getting shorter. The next moment I was drifting through a grayish tunnel of clouds. I felt like I had a body but could not feel it. (It has been so long I am sure I have lost memory of some of the details.) What stood out was the clouds seem to have beings guiding me through. Then this bright light, which would be normally blinding to the human eye, was in front of me. I heard my grandmother’s voice calling me and then she slowly came into focus and greeted me. She told me that I have to ‘turn around and go back, this is not your time’. I still ‘have to do what you were meant to do on earth’. If I pass her, I will ‘not be able to return’. She knew that I could feel the love and peace; but she also felt that I was afraid. She told me the fear that I was feeling is the guilt of leaving before doing what I was meant to do. I understood and felt like this was more of a lesson that was being taught. She said she will always watch over me. In an instant, I was gasping for air and had the worse headache that I ever experienced until this day. This headache was so bad I must have passed out again. When I finally awoke, I still had an awful headache and was extremely thirsty. The ring of my cellphone later awakened me but I had missed the call. I then realized that I had over 20 missed calls and it was now Saturday 7 pm. I called my friend and told him I was okay. Once the headache was gone, I felt connected to the universe and was more aware of everything. I had the love that I brought back with me and the knowledge of knowing I am being watched over; I have a purpose. I considered Thanksgiving being like a ‘new’ birthday.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: He reports drifting through a grayish tunnel of clouds and 'felt like I had a body but could not feel it.'

arrival.other_being_detail: He reports 'the clouds seem to have beings guiding me through.'

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Grandmother said he still 'have to do what you were meant to do on earth' and that if he passed her he would 'not be able to return.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Possible drugging/poisoning after accepting a drink; he felt shaking, dizziness, extreme tiredness, then lay down and felt breaths getting shorter.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He also reports 'beings guiding me through' the clouds and hearing his grandmother’s voice before seeing her.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel of clouds with guiding beings, then bright light, then grandmother appears and delivers boundary/return message, then instant return to body with gasping and severe headache.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reports being drugged and later awakening to find it was Saturday 7 pm after the event occurred Thursday afternoon, with severe headache and thirst on waking.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “turn around and go back, this is not your time” / “have to do what you were meant to do on earth” / “not be able to return” / He later felt “connected to the universe” and called Thanksgiving a “new” birthday.
